desktop.account.title: Ngena ku-getcadcraft.com
desktop.account.signed_out.text: Ukungena kuvumela lolu hlelo lokusebenza ukuvula nokulondoloza imizobo yakho yefu. Uthola ikhodi emfushane lapha bese uyigunyaza ewebhusayithini, kusiphequluli sakho. Akukho okuyimfihlo okuthayiwa noma okukopishwa.
desktop.account.waiting.title: Gunyaza le khodi ewebhusayithini
desktop.account.waiting.text: Isiphequluli sakho sivule i-getcadcraft.com/device. Hlola ukuthi ikhombisa le khodi, bese uyigunyaza.
desktop.account.waiting.own: Gunyaza ikhodi ekhonjiswe lapha kuphela, kuhlelo lwakho.
desktop.account.signed_in.title: Ungenile
desktop.account.signed_in.text: Le khompyutha ihlala ingene kuze kube yilapho uphuma lapha, noma uyisusa ku-getcadcraft.com ngaphansi kwe-I-akhawunti, Ukuvikeleka.
desktop.account.only_desktop: Lo windi usebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kohlelo lwe-CadCraft lwedesktop.
desktop.reason.throttled: Amakhodi amaningi ngesikhathi esifushane. Zama futhi emizuzwini embalwa.
desktop.reason.expired: Ikhodi iphelelwe yisikhathi ngaphambi kokuthi igunyazwe. Cela enye.
desktop.reason.revoked: Le khompyutha iphume ku-getcadcraft.com. Ngena futhi ukuze usebenzise imizobo yakho yefu; akukho okulahlekile kule khompyutha.
desktop.reason.offline_signout: Uphume kule khompyutha. Iwebhusayithi ayikwazanga ukufinyelelwa: ukungena kuphinde kudweshwe ku-getcadcraft.com/account/security, lapho ungakususa khona.
desktop.reason.keystore: Indawo yokugcina izitifiketi yalo kompyutha yenqabe ukungena.
desktop.carry.title: Ilungiselela i-CadCraft Studio
desktop.carry.text: Kuletha izilungiselelo zakho, amafayela akamuva kanye namakhophi okubuyisa kusuka ezinhlelweni ezihlukile ezifakwe ngaphambili.
